title: Zigzag Level Sum of Binary Tree
summary: At each one-based odd tree level, inspect nodes left-to-right and sum only those before the first node lacking a left child. At even levels inspect right-to-left, stopping before the first node lacking a right child. Return a sum for every level, including zero when the first node fails. Traverse the full tree to form subsequent levels.
